meta.title: Ingri
meta.description: English for Azerbaijani speakers: podcasts, grammar, listening, speaking, and words.

auth.loginText: Sign in and pick up today’s lesson.
auth.name: Name
auth.forgotText: If an account exists, we send a reset link.
auth.resetText: The link lasts 30 minutes and works once.
auth.verifyText: The link in your inbox opens the account.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with upper and lower case, a number, and a symbol.
auth.CHECK_EMAIL: If the address can be used, check your inbox. Without Gmail configured, the link is printed in the API log.
auth.INVALID_TOKEN: This link has expired or was already used.
auth.EMAIL_VERIFIED: Email verified. You can log in now.
auth.VALIDATION: Check the form and try again.
auth.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again later.
auth.INVALID_CSRF: Refresh the page and try again.
auth.passwordWeak: The password doesn't meet the rules yet.
auth.usernameHint: 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dot and underscore.
auth.usernameInvalid: Only lowercase letters, numbers, “.” and “_” — 3–20 characters.
auth.USERNAME_TAKEN: This username is already taken. Try another one.
auth.USE_GOOGLE: This account was created with Google. Use “Continue with Google”.
auth.googleError: Google sign-in didn't work. Please try again.
auth.checkInboxText: We sent a link to {email}. Can't find it? Check your spam folder too.
auth.verifyResendText: No email yet? Enter your address and we'll send it again.
auth.terms: By continuing you accept the Ingri terms.
auth.brandTitle: Learn English a little every day
auth.brandText: Podcasts, grammar, speaking practice and an AI tutor — all in one place, matched to your level.

dashboard.inviteText: Learning together makes the streak more fun.
dashboard.feature2t: Say the phrase and see a score right away.
dashboard.feature3t: Lock in grammar with a few questions.
dashboard.a1: Content is on the server. Progress is saved to your account.
dashboard.a2: On the speaking page you can type the same sentence.
dashboard.a3: Each active day adds one. Miss a day and it starts again.

podcasts.title: Short podcasts
podcasts.text: Listen, follow the transcript, and keep the new words.
podcasts.noTranscriptText: Listen carefully, then move on to the glossary and quiz.

grammar.title: Grammar lessons
grammar.text: A short explanation, examples, and a separate quiz.
grammar.question: Question {n} / {total}

listening.title: Listen and answer
listening.text: Play the dialogue, then answer the questions.

speaking.title: Say it aloud
speaking.text: Repeat the phrase. The browser writes what it hears.
speaking.again: A few words differed. Try once more.
speaking.unsupported: This browser cannot recognize speech. Type the sentence.

words.title: Essential words
words.text: English, Azerbaijani, and a short example.
words.cardsText: See the word, recall the translation, then flip.
words.credit: Headword order follows the New General Service List (CC BY-SA). Definitions, examples, and Azerbaijani translations are original to this app.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.text: Ranked by XP. First place wears the crown.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.fileHint: JPEG, PNG, or WebP. 2 MB maximum.
profile.securityText: Change your password or delete the account.
profile.deleteWarn: This cannot be undone. Enter your password.
profile.setPasswordText: Your account uses Google sign-in. Set a password if you also want to sign in with email.

settings.title: Settings
settings.text: Study several levels at once. The active level filters lessons.

plan.title: Learning plan
plan.text: Daily minutes, target level, and date. Steps follow the active level.
plan.empty: No plan for this level yet.

onboarding.title: What is my level?
onboarding.text: A short test suggests a level. Accept it or choose your own.
onboarding.timeUpText: We calculated your level from the questions you answered.

videos.title: Videos
videos.text: Verified lesson videos. Watch time counts as listening.

movies.title: Films
movies.text: Recommendations by level. Official trailers only. This app does not stream films.

books.title: Books
books.text: Public-domain texts. Reading time counts as reading.

notes.title: Notes
notes.text: Every note you write while studying lives here.
notes.emptyText: Use the “Notes” tab on the right to jot down a note on any page.

completion.noneYet: Nothing completed yet. Watch a video or listen to a podcast!

chat.subtitle: Your English tutor · {level}
chat.intro: I'm Ingri. I can explain grammar, correct your sentences, translate words and suggest lessons for your level.
chat.s2: Correct this: I goed to school yesterday
chat.s3: How do I say “səbirli” in English?
chat.s4: What should I study at my level?

errors.RATE_LIMITED: You're sending messages too fast, wait a minute.
errors.BAD_KEY: The AI key is invalid or out of quota. Check back/.env.

chat.hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line

grammar.title: Grammar
grammar.p1: What's the difference between Present Perfect and Past Simple?

translate.title: Translate
translate.p1: How do I say “Sabah görüşərik” in English?
translate.p2: What does “I'm looking forward to it” mean?

speaking.title: Practice speaking
speaking.p1: Let's practise ordering at a café.

chat.pickQuestion: Pick a question or type your own:

datatable.emptyText: Change the filters or clear the search.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.text: Theme, colour, font size and sounds. Applied instantly on this device and saved to your profile.
appearance.reducedMotionHint: Turns off transitions and moving effects.
appearance.soundHint: Correct/wrong answers, streak and chat sounds.
